## What this is
A small local Python CLI (`python3 remediate.py`) for your NCLEX-PN / Canadian RPN prep. It reads your missed-question tags in `seed/missed.json` (topic, client need, why you missed it) and prints a remediation plan. The default is 7 days; `--days` accepts 3–30. The plan opens with a breakdown of why you missed questions and which topics you missed more than once. Then come topic days, a review day and a final practice-exam day. All 48 tests pass, and the CLI runs.

- **Standard library only, local only, no network.**
